verdict.rationale: Intel's own AI software stack documents support for this processor family. oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations are documented for Core Ultra series 2 (the 258V's family) for LLM and image-generation inference, and OpenVINO documents its NPU device for Core Ultra processors. None of this names the 258V specifically, OpenVINO's NPU page cites Meteor Lake rather than Lunar Lake, and no evidence covers the third-party runtimes the story names. missing for 10: documentation naming the 258V/Lunar Lake explicitly in OpenVINO device support, evidence of llama.cpp, MLX or ONNX Runtime support, independent or hands-on corroboration of runtimes running on its CPU/GPU/NPU

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU

citations.quote: Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2) and Intel® Arc™ GPUs.

The Neural Processing Unit is a low-power hardware solution, introduced with the Intel® Core™ Ultra generation of CPUs (formerly known as Meteor Lake). It enables you to offload certain neural network computation tasks from other devices
Optimize performance on client GPUs and NPUs from Intel with new analysis tool features in Intel® VTune™ Profiler.
